scope: Phase 9D2C general-pasteboard exact restoration safety discovery
purpose: Prove that the current user's general pasteboard can be completely materialized, temporarily replaced with test-owned data, and restored item/type/byte-exact before any public typed-write physical validation is attempted.

resultPolicy.BLOCKED: Any current native pasteboard type cannot be materialized, the backup exceeds the safety budget, or the pasteboard changes during the pre-mutation backup. No mutation is allowed in these cases.
resultPolicy.FAIL: Mutation occurred but test-owned mutation or exact restoration could not be independently verified. The failure must remain immutable evidence.
resultPolicy.PASS: Backup completed before mutation, test-owned mutation was observed, and every original item/type/data byte was restored exactly.

nextStepOnPass: Prepare a separate Phase 9D2C public typed-write physical validation session that uses the proven restoration mechanism around actual runtime/SDK writeClipboardFormat calls.
nextStepOnBlockedOrFail: Do not run public typed-write mutation validation. Diagnose restoration limitations and preserve this session as immutable evidence.
